name: Jismakiah
title: Levite under King Hezekiah
summary: Jismakiah was a Levite who served during King Hezekiah's religious reforms in Judah. He is mentioned as one of the overseers over the gifts, tithes, and holy contributions in the house of the Lord. He worked under the leadership of Konaniah and his brother Shimei.

keyEvents.title: Overseer over temple gifts
keyEvents.description: Jismakiah was appointed as one of the overseers over the voluntary gifts to God, the tithes, and the holy contributions in the temple during King Hezekiah's reform.

keyEvents.title: Hezekiah's temple reform
keyEvents.description: As part of King Hezekiah's extensive religious reforms, the Levites were organized to manage the people's gifts and tithes for the temple. Jismakiah was among those given responsibility in this administration.

keyEvents.title: Service under Konaniah's leadership
keyEvents.description: Jismakiah served under the Levite Konaniah and his brother Shimei, who had primary responsibility for collecting gifts for the house of the Lord, by order of King Hezekiah.

keyEvents.title: Restoration of the Worship Service
keyEvents.description: Hezekiah restored true worship in Judah after his father Ahaz's idolatry. The Levites, including Jishmaiah, played a key role in organizing the renewed temple service.
